title: Neuropathic Pruritus Algorithm
subtitle: Localized dysesthesia, dermatomes, and neurologic clues

steps.prompt: Is itch localized with burning, tingling, pain, numbness, or alloknesis?
Upper back/medial scapula with secondary hyperpigmentation?
Dorsolateral forearms worsened by sun or cervical disease?
Screen for zoster, small-fiber neuropathy, radiculopathy, CNS lesion, or medication neuropathy

citations.quote: Robinson C et al. Notalgia paresthetica: an updated review of pathophysiology, diagnosis, and treatment approaches. Curr Pain Headache Rep. 2025.
StatPearls Brachioradial Pruritus review describes localized neuropathic dysesthesia and diagnostic considerations.
